title: Brahmacharya
tagline: Right use of energy for spiritual growth
description: Right use of energy for spiritual growth

sections.theme: Five vows for a life well-lived.

sutra.meaning: Ahimsa (non-violence/non-injury), Satya (truthfulness), Asteya (non-stealing), Brahmacharya (right use of energy/continence), and Aparigraha (non-possessiveness/non-greed) are the five Yamas (restraints or social codes)
sutra.padaVibhaga: ahiṁsā | satya | asteya | brahmacarya | aparigrahāḥ | yamāḥ
sutra.wordMeanings: ahiṁsā = non-violence; satya = truthfulness; asteya = non-stealing; brahmacarya = continence; aparigrahāḥ = non-possessiveness; yamāḥ = restraints

sections.reflectionPrompt: Did I live these today? Which can I work on? Which is difficult for me?
sections.practice: Observe yourself and note how many times you strayed or were tempted to stray from adhering to the Yamas
sections.journalPrompt: Which of the Yamas did I not follow.
sections.gurudevInsight: Ahimasa, satya, Ashteya, Brahmacharya, Aparigraha. Ahimsa - nonviolence Satya - Truth Astheya - non stealing Brahmacharya - moving in Brahman, moving in the bigness. jaatideshkaalsamayanva chinahsaalbhauka mahavrutta These are the greatest because it is applicable in all time in all places for all people throughout, without an interruption. There are certain laws, which can apply just to certain people, certain places, at certain time, which are not universal, but these are universal

sutra.wordMeanings: brahmacarya = continence; pratiṣṭhāyām = when established; vīrya = vitality; lābhaḥ = gain

sections.reflectionPrompt: Where did I waste energy?Did I have a misconception about Brahmacharya in its sense of celibacy?
sections.gurudevInsight: Brahmacharayapratisthayam veeryalaabha d) Brahmacharya: - Said as Celibacy. Celibacy brings you strength; a lot of strength but Brahmacharya has a deeper or bigger meaning than just celibacy. Brahma means the infinity & charya means moving in the infinity. Knowing your vast nature, not thinking you are just a body but you walk like you are a glow of light, you move in the world as though you are the space. When you sitting in meditation, you don’t feel you are a body, you are a lump of a heavy weight, 80 pounds or 90 pounds or 100 pounds body, you don’t feel you are 60 kg sitting their solid. You feel so light, you feel, as though like a feather, isn’t it?
